description: This file defines an API router for AI completion endpoints within a project management platform. It handles user authentication, context fetching from the database, and interactions with the OpenAI API for generating AI-powered responses, both streamed and non-streamed.

classes.name: AICompletionRequest
classes.description: Request model for AI completion, encapsulating prompt, context IDs, streaming preference, and model override.

classes.name: AICompletionChunk
classes.description: Data model representing a chunk of streamed AI completion text.

classes.name: AICompletionResponse
classes.description: Response model for non-streaming AI completions, including the generated content and used metadata.

methods.name: dict _get_current_user_payload(authorization: Optional[str] = Header(default=None))
methods.description: Extracts and validates user info from Bearer token in headers to obtain payload data.

methods.name: str _fetch_context_text(org_id: str, project_id: Optional[str], task_id: Optional[str])
methods.description: Asynchronously loads relevant project and task context information from the database to inform the AI prompt.

methods.name: _get_openai_client()
methods.description: Creates and returns an OpenAI client instance using environment variable API key.

methods.name: str _build_system_prompt()
methods.description: Constructs a fixed instructive prompt to guide the AI assistant's behavior.

methods.name: list[dict] _compose_messages(user_prompt: str, context_text: str)
methods.description: Assembles the message sequence for the chat completion API, including system instructions, context, and user prompt.

methods.name: AsyncGenerator[bytes,None] _stream_chat(client, model: str, messages: list[dict])
methods.description: Streams AI completion tokens as plain text chunks from the OpenAI chat completion API.

methods.name: ai_complete( data: AICompletionRequest = Body(...), payload: dict = Depends(_get_current_user_payload), )
methods.description: Main API endpoint for generating AI completions, with support for streaming and context-aware responses.
